name: Tirhakah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Hearing that Tirhakah king of Ethiopia has come out to fight against him, Sennacherib sends messengers again to Hezekiah with a threatening letter.

note.label: 2 Kings 19: The Most High Defends Jerusalem
